Current written-provision review · Scope labels. Initial judgements below are retained as the earlier inspection; the current review rechecks the follow-up teaching and practice.

All 519 leaf source items have been inspected in 111 related-demand groups. The earlier candidate retrieval is retained as a separate historical method; these substantive judgements nominate stronger existing evidence and identify specific weaknesses.

98 groups supported; 13 partial at initial inspection. Original teaching additions now address the identified instructional gaps and are linked below. They await independent re-review. Network-symbol fidelity and actual debugger, classroom and practical observations remain checks to perform, not results claimed. Group counts are not a coverage percentage. There are zero independent teacher sign-offs.

“Supported” means substantive explanation/example and relevant practice were located. “Partial” identifies a specified depth/alignment weakness. Parent bullets provide context to their reviewed leaves. Exact official wording remains in the source PDF; item IDs and grouping are editorial. School-issued assessment mapping and school adoption remain separate.
